title: Te Kaitiaki o te Kūaha o te Rā e Puta Ana
intro: I roto i te Quran, ka haereere ētahi wairua i te ao, ka waiho ngā ara o te whakaaro nui me te miharo. I haere tētahi o aua tangata ki ngā wāhi tawhiti rawa o te hanganga—te wāhi e whiti ai, e tō ai te rā, te wāhi e ārai ana i te pōrearea. I whakawhiwhia tēnei pononga a Allah ki tētahi rangatiratanga e kore e riro i tētahi atu. Nā roto i ngā haerenga motuhake e toru, i mārama ai te kaupapa o tēnei tangata. Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i tēnei tangata haereere rongonui i roto i ngā atarangi o te hītori?
clues: I homai ki ahau te mana e te Atua Aroha rawa kia whakahaere i te whenua i tētahi ara kāore anō kia tutuki i tētahi atu.
I haere ahau ki te hauauru tae noa ki te wāhi e torengi ai te rā, ā, i kite ahau e torengi ana i roto i te puna pouri, ā, i kite ahau i tētahi iwi i reira.
I haere ahau ki te rawhiti tae noa ki te wāhi e whiti ana te rā, e kite ana ahau e whiti ana ki runga i tētahi iwi kāore mātou i whakarato i tētahi piringa mō rātou i reira.
I haere ahau i waenganui i aua pito e rua tae noa ki te taenga atu ki tētahi awaawa i waenganui i ngā maunga e rua, ā, ka kitea e au tētahi iwi kāore i te tino mārama ki te kōrero.

I kitea e au i runga i te maunga e rua ngā arai rino mārō e toro atu ana ki te taha matau, ki te taha maui, ā, i waenganui i a rāua, he ara whaiti. I tono mai ēnei tāngata kia wahia e au te arai e pupuri ana i te ngangau.

I tangohia e au taku kai, ā, ka mea atu ahau: 'Ina pakaru te arai, ka mārama te wehenga i waenganui i a tātou ko tēnei iwi.' Ā, i te taenga mai o te wā i whakaritea, ka mātakitaki ahau i te pakarutanga o te arai.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
